title: Short-period n/alpha lower limit (Figure 3, Category C, Classes I, II-C, IV): Level 2, Category C

ruleset.name: MIL-F-8785C
ruleset.basis: Class IV; bare airframe; the classical modes of the linear model are the equivalent system (3.1.12)

notes: Vertical hatched box edges on Figure 3 (not printed numerically): Level 1 edge graphically ~2.7 g/rad, Level 2 edge ~1.7 g/rad (+/-0.05). Level 3: none (CAP 0.096 line with straight-line extension below n/alpha=1).
